For years the targets were whatever crawled out of the old Arks. Then the Choir's collectors began coming into the fog, and the Hex Sniper found a better use for all that patience: watching over the Warden's crew from a very long way off.

payload.long: The Hex Stalker hunts through the Arkgrave's fog and never shoots twice from the same spot. Fen-dark children are told the Hex Stalker can't be caught, which is true, and eats the disobedient, which is not. Whatever is draining the fen villages keeps moving too, and the Hex Stalker joined the Warden because it takes a hunter to follow it.

payload.long: The Hex Warden marks the Fen-dark's borders with curses nobody sees until they step on one. Curse-work leaves its mark on whoever does it, and the Hex Warden has done a great deal of it. The villages around the Arkgrave sleep easier for it, though nobody invites the Hex Warden to supper. The Warden's crew asked politely, which was new, so the Hex Warden came along to keep their road clear.

payload.name: The Anchor's Heave
payload.short: An anchor is sunk somewhere on the field each wave. Every few seconds it heaves, and everyone within three tiles is dragged a step toward it. Set up a line the heave will close.

payload.name: Cracking Floor
payload.short: Cracked tiles give under every step, every turn spent standing and every blow; a crumbling tile caves in when its icon reaches the edge of the timeline, and whoever stands on it falls.

payload.name: Fire Trail
payload.short: Ember beasts leave burning ground behind them; it scorches whoever steps in or stands on it. Ice douses it, and it burns out on its own.

payload.name: Hold Barricades
payload.short: Every wave, the holds throw up barricades. Stand beside one to wear it down; when it falls, step onto the rubble to be Empowered.

payload.name: Holy Light
payload.short: Holy power leaves the ground glowing for a few seconds. In Morrow's Dark it shows any foe standing in it, and a foe that starts its turn in it is Blinded.

payload.name: Ice Trail
payload.short: Frost beasts leave ice in their tracks; it slows whoever steps on it, and sometimes freezes them solid. Fire melts it.

payload.name: Land Mines
payload.short: Bulwark gunners plant mines as they march. Step on one, shove a foe onto it, or hit it from range and it arms: the blast lands on the timeline a moment later. A Disarm Kit pulls it safely.

payload.name: Morrow's Dark
payload.short: In Morrow's Shadow the Manalith blots out the sky, and there is no light but the braziers. A foe more than two tiles from every hero, and off the brazier-light, is hidden on the field and its timeline icon is a question mark.

payload.name: The Rising Tide
payload.short: Each wave the water rises from the bottom row, one row at a time, and you can see each rise coming on the timeline. Anyone who starts a turn in the flood is Slowed and Wet, and lightning finds the Wet.

payload.name: Shardfall
payload.short: Shards fall on the party: each strike shows on the timeline and its tiles light up before it lands. Where one lands it leaves a crystal; end a turn on it for a Ward.

payload.name: Slime Trail
payload.short: Slimes leave a sticky trail as they go; stepping in it slows you. Fire burns it away, and Purifying Salts wash it off.
